Windows or Linux for your dedicated server? 

Linux distributions are open-source and free, making them perfect for #WordPress, #Docker, and #PHP. #WindowsServer adds a monthly licensing fee, but is strictly required if your apps use .NET or MSSQL.

Read our full 2026 breakdown here:
